backend-architect.description: Design critique + plan for a change (new module/service/field/transition, multi-module work). Writes only the ticket's Plan section; never source code.

fullstack-developer.description: Implements ONE closed, scoped step of a ticket across config/sync, lib/modules and lib/themes, runs the gate and returns a summary. Use for implementation delegated by /ticket.

code-reviewer.description: Independent, read-only, clean-context review of the current diff against the review checklist and known issues. Use before handing a change over (/review).

knowledge-auditor.description: Keeps .ai consistent: runs scan-references, investigates each broken or suspicious reference (git history, where/callers) and proposes fixes with evidence. Edits only .ai/ after approval. Use via /audit.

skill-curator.description: At the end of a ticket decides, with evidence, whether to EDIT an existing skill, CREATE a new one or do NOTHING, always asks the human with its recommendation, and writes the skill only after a yes. Use via /skill or /close.

code-scout.description: Read-only lookups: where a status / field / role / method lives (touchpoints, where, callers, impact), returned as a short summary in a clean context. Use via /touchpoints or @code-scout.

gate-runner.description: Runs the project's gate (the stacks' linters, static analysis, build/cache and smoke checks) on the changed files and returns pass/fail with only the error lines and the [VERIFIED] evidence strings. Use via /gate or after each implementation block.

debugger.description: Finds and proves the root cause of a bug (prior art, where/callers, max 3 hypotheses, git log -S / blame, watchdog) and returns a diagnosis without fixing it. Use via /debug for correctives with an unknown cause.

security-reviewer.description: Independent read-only security pass on the current diff: access control, ownership/delegation, injection, data exposure, CSRF, secrets. Use via /security for changes to access, roles, web services or personal data.

jira-writer.description: Drafts the Jira analysis comment, test instructions and worklog from a ticket file into its ## Jira drafts section. Never writes to Jira. Use via /jira.

test-designer.description: Turns a change into a manual re-test checklist (role · status · language · action → expected) from the ticket's Impact and the skills of the affected flows. Use via /tests.

ticket.description: Start or resume a ticket: prior art, intent, plan, implement, gate, stop for validation. Usage: /ticket <JIRA-KEY|request>

plan.description: Design critique + plan written into the ticket (backend-architect subagent). Usage: /plan [key]

gate.description: Run the gate of the project's stacks and get only pass/fail + error lines (gate-runner). Usage: /gate [paths]

impact.description: Which workflows (skills), past bugs and past tickets the current change can affect, with a re-test checklist. Usage: /impact [key | --files … | --base ref]

touchpoints.description: Every place a status / field / role / method lives, summarised by a read-only subagent. Usage: /touchpoints term1, term2 [— question]

debug.description: Root cause of a bug, proven, without fixing it (debugger). Usage: /debug <symptom or key>

review.description: Independent read-only review of the current diff (code-reviewer subagent). Usage: /review [key]

security.description: Independent security pass on the current diff (security-reviewer). Usage: /security [key]

tests.description: Manual re-test checklist from the ticket's impact (test-designer). Usage: /tests [key]

end.description: End the session: confirm, update Current state + Session log + journal. Usage: /end [key]

close.description: Close a ticket: verification, known issue, skill/context staleness, commit messages. Usage: /close [key]

jira.description: Jira drafts: analysis comment, test instructions, worklog (jira-writer). Usage: /jira [key]

skill.description: Should this work update a skill, create one, or nothing? Recommends and asks (skill-curator). Usage: /skill [key]

learn.description: Capture a lesson into the right skill / known issue / convention (proposed first). Usage: /learn [lesson]

scan.description: Run the four knowledge-base drift scanners and report what must be updated.

audit.description: Check every reference of the knowledge base and propose fixes with evidence (knowledge-auditor). Usage: /audit [id]

doctor.description: Check this checkout's AI set-up (hooks, opencode wiring, indexes, exec environment, ai-core version) and say how to fix each problem. Usage: /doctor
